fix: Remote Linux over SSH (Block 18): Install, Update, Start, Stop, Restart, Logs, Health, Config, Backup and Restore of CoD4x servers on a Linux machine, agentless (ssh2 + SFTP + fixed command list). Key-only login from the encrypted vault (subject ssh_<hostId>), host key pinned only after the operator confirmed the exact SHA-256 value, changed key = hard stop before any login, no root, remote paths validated, commands only from lib/remote-commands.mjs. RCON, console, B3, master, monitoring and phone gateway are not available for remote servers yet.
